newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Fifty-three killed in Pakistan bus crash.
newsitem.headline: Fifty-three killed in Pakistan bus crash.

text.p: A bus plunged off a mountain road into a deep ravine in northwestern Pakistan, killing all 53 people aboard, most of them going home to celebrate a Moslem festival, the state APP news agency said on Friday.

Those killed in the crash on Thursday evening near Kohat town in the North West Frontier province included 51 recruits of the paramilitary Frontier Constabulary going home from a training centre to celebrate Eid al-Fitr, it said.
The other two dead were the bus driver and the conductor, APP said.
Eid al-Fitr marks the end of the fasting month of Ramadan.
